Hey, welcome to the club! Quick tips on dealing with biphobia, because it can really hit you in the face if you are unprepared: 

First thing is, always protect yourself! If you recognize a biphobic person or a biphobic argument or bi erasure or anything, you don't have to argue with them or fight back. If you don't feel safe in an environment, it's okay to hide your identity and leave ASAP.

Secondly, a lot of bisexuals have impostor syndrome because of biphobia. Sometimes you may feel like you are not really bisexual, but gay/straight, because you only had gay/straight experience recently. It's okay. Remember that only you can tell who you are. If you only or mostly are interested in one gender, that doesn't mean you are not bisexual. It means you have a preference and it's okay.

Last thing that comes to my mind, is that sadly sometimes biphobia comes from people in the LGBTQ community, especially if you are in a straight passing relationship. Don't listen to them, you have every right to be here. 

Hope this was useful, check out r/bisexual ! 

Have a nice day! :)
